gbm_population_evidence.quote: High Grade Glioma; Ependymoma; Embryonal Tumor of Brain; Recurrence; Refractory; Pediatric; Young Adult
Patients with recurrent or refractory high grade malignant brain tumors (high grade glioma, embryonal CNS tumors \[medulloblastomas, ATRT, EMTR, pineoblastoma\], and ependymomas)

candidate_evidence.quote: DNX-2401, a genetically modified adenovirus type 5

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Intratumoral DNX-2401 Administration for Recurrent and Refractory High Grade Brain Tumors in Pediatric and Young Adult Patients

role_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] DNX-2401: Single intratumoral infusion of 5 × 10\^10 viral particles of DNX-2401 after tumor biopsy.

agents.drug_class_hint: DNX-2401 (Delta-24-RGD), conditionally replicating oncolytic adenovirus type 5, intratumoral
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: replicates in and destroys only tumor cells while activating the patient's immune system

coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult (1-25 y) recurrent high-grade brain tumours; glioblastoma is never named (only 'high grade glioma', DIPG/DMG mentioned in description). Sole intervention is an oncolytic virus (excluded type). Viral kinetics and immune response sampling in tumour/CSF relate to the excluded virus, not a pharmacological candidate, so PK/TE coded no. 'Molecular composition' of tumour samples is a vague correlative aim, no specific biomarker named.
